description: Structured Topic Bank for Duolingo Speak — Categorizing Free Conversation vs Structured Roleplay Scenarios

topics.title: Greeting & Small Talk
topics.description: Casual greetings, warm-up introductions, and general small talk without forced scenarios.

topics.title: Free Discussion & Chit-Chat
topics.description: Open-ended natural conversation on any everyday topic.

topics.title: Childhood Memories
topics.description: Share memorable childhood stories and family traditions.

topics.title: Best Friends & Personality
topics.description: Discuss friendship, personality traits, and personal values.

topics.title: School & Education
topics.description: Talk about favorite subjects, study routines, and student life.

topics.title: Hobbies & Free Time
topics.description: Discuss leisure activities, sports, music, and weekend fun.

Focus on table reservations, menu specials, and paying the check.

Focus on discussing career goals, salary expectations, and company culture fit.

topics.title: Hotel Reservation & Check-In
